Question
========
Explain the following concept, spelling out the acronym first if there is one. Give its definition and its usage, and if it has several usages, its most important one.

**Hardware Prefetching**

Solution
========
Logic in the CPU that detects a regular access pattern, sequential or with a constant stride, and fetches the next cachelines before they are requested, so that the memory latency is hidden.
